text.title: Roadmap Design Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of Roadmap Design. Followed by two shorter Now-Next-Later sketches: B2B SaaS and solo product Now-Next-Later roadmap examples, and common roadmap antipatterns with fixes. The antipatterns live in `content/03-failure-modes.xml`.

example.scenario: Solo SaaS, 3-quarter horizon, medium uncertainty, 2 audiences (internal team + customer). r6 picks Now/Next/Later. Internal source-of-truth: 2 items in Now (high confidence), 3 in Next (medium), 4 in Later (low), each linked to one of 3 outcomes (activate / retain / monetise), plus 3 explicit exclusions with reasons. External derivative: 3 themes only — 'faster signup', 'better admin', 'API' — no metric targets, no confidence labels, no owners. Cadence: monthly internal review, quarterly external publish.
example.trace: r6-format-by-uncertainty → r1-outcome-not-feature → r2-three-horizons → r3-confidence-labels → r10-not-doing-list → r7-one-source-many-views → r8-no-external-metric-targets → r9-publish-cadence → validated artefact

artefact.code: { "artefact_id": "roadmap-design-example", "version": "1.0.0", "last_reviewed": "2026-05-23", "horizon_quarters": 3, "uncertainty": "medium", "format": "now-next-later", "horizons": [ "now/activation-time-to-value", "next/admin-self-service", "later/public-api" ], "external_themes": [ "faster signup", "better admin", "API" ], "not_doing": [ "custom themes — not on the ICP roadmap this year", "white-labelling — no paying demand", "multi-language UI — insufficient international demand" ], "confidence_rubric": { "high": "committed and scoped", "medium": "planned, needs scoping", "low": "exploring, tentative" }, "review_cadence": "internal monthly; external quarterly", "audience": "internal team + customer", "owner": "@solo-founder" }

example.title: B2B SaaS Now-Next-Later
example.note: Now (Q1): onboarding improvements (reduce time to value), API v2 launch (enterprise requirement), performance optimization (load times). Each tied to objective: "Improve activation rate to 40%".
Next (Q2): team collaboration features (confidence: High), Slack integration (confidence: Medium), advanced permissions (confidence: Medium). Depends on: API v2 stable.
Later: mobile app (pending user research validation), AI-powered insights (exploring, no commitment). Explicitly not doing: custom themes, white-labelling — not on enterprise ICP roadmap this year.

example.title: Solo product Now-Next-Later
example.note: Now: core feature polish toward MLP, payment integration, basic analytics.
Next: email automation, template library, referral program.
Later: mobile app, team features, marketplace. Not doing: multi-language support — insufficient international user demand to justify.
Fits on one screen per r11-one-screen; three items in Now stays under the r14 cap.
